definitionOfCompletion: One or more editorial topic candidates found. NOT an exact answer match, textual source verification, historical question wording verification or publication.
publicationRules: Never consider broad topic correspondence an approved answer.
Preserve historical IDs and original bank/interlocutor identity; do not rephrase historic question as a canonical title.
Do not conflate historically distinct traditions or denominations.
The Canon is a presentation role, original source/authority is not transferred from APOL/CR/Sexual Ethics/Catechism/Mass Explorer.
Individual question must be checked against original proponents, primary/source texts, the Catholic teaching, English/French versions, and human editorial approval.
If topical candidates are absent, this is a missing dedicated topic in the 282-record comparison; it does not prove no answer anywhere.
Older conversation quotations have no byte-level raw-transcript verification.
This record does not create new dialogue answers, public app routes, or change release gates.
